scrutiny.test: T0 purpose: prismis ingests third-party content unattended; letting a third-party link steer cerebro's fetcher at the home network would make the system a pivot into the LAN. Refusing non-public addresses keeps ingestion to the public web it is for.
scrutiny.failureCase: The guard reduced what prismis can ingest from its actual sources.

scrutiny.test: T1 owners: constitution.md:86 (additive change) is met by reading the new key with a default; constitution 10 (validate input where it enters) is what the guard implements at the one entry point for article URLs.
scrutiny.failureCase: An owner required the key or forbade a config-scoped exception.

scrutiny.test: T6 assumptions verified: Python 3.13's http.client.HTTPConnection holds `_create_connection` as an instance attribute (socket.create_connection), the hook the guarded connection replaces; `ipaddress.is_global` is False for 127.0.0.1, 10.0.0.1, 192.168.1.1, 169.254.169.254, 100.64.0.1, ::1, ::ffff:127.0.0.1 and fd00::1 and True for 8.8.8.8 and 2606:4700::1111, on this Mac (3.13.15) and on cerebro (3.13.5) for the mapped form.
scrutiny.failureCase: The hook or the classification behaved differently than the design assumes.

scrutiny.test: T2 same noun: the check runs on the addresses getaddrinfo returned and the socket connects to one of those same addresses, so the claim 'checked address = connected address' rests on the connect call, not on a pre-flight lookup.
scrutiny.failureCase: A pre-flight check resolved the name separately from the connection, leaving a rebinding window.

scrutiny.test: T3 degrades: LAN-hosted article links become title-only unless allowed; no current source has one (cerebro query); proxied requests check the proxy address.
T4 reuse: extends `_http_only_opener` and the existing `[daemon]` config section, following `deep_extract_exclude`'s optional-list read.
scrutiny.failureCase: A second downloader or a parallel config mechanism were added.

scrutiny.test: T7 callers of extract_article, enumerated with `grep -rn 'extract_article(' daemon/src`: fetchers/rss.py:267, fetchers/reddit.py:449, refetch.py:194; all pass their config's allow list.
scrutiny.failureCase: A caller fetched article URLs outside the guard.

scrutiny.test: T8 shape: the check is structural, in the connection the opener builds, so redirects need no separate handling; the exception is a named host list, not a boolean off switch.
scrutiny.failureCase: A redirect handler re-implemented the check, or a global flag disabled it.

scrutiny.test: T5 real-system proof: after deploy, the next fetch cycles on cerebro show `fetch_failed:blocked address` only for links that resolve to non-public addresses, by grouping new items' title_only_reason.
scrutiny.failureCase: The only proof were local tests.

scrutiny.test: T10 undo: revert the commit; the config key is optional and ignored by older code.
